meta.subject: fixed shared memory multi-tag requests bug

en.summary: Fixes shared-memory read-response assembly so bank replies with different tags are returned in separate batches instead of being merged together.
why_it_counts: The patch is entirely in shared-memory RTL.
It changes live response selection, batching, and queue-pop timing for read replies.
Without the fix, data from different tagged requests can be mixed on one response bus.
evidence: The commit introduces bank_rsp_sel state to track which bank replies for the current tag have already been sent.
core_rsp_tag_in is selected first, then only banks whose CORE_TAG_ID_BITS match that tag are forwarded.
creq_pop now waits for crsq_in_fire_last instead of popping a read request as soon as the response skid buffer is ready.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A banked shared-memory or scratchpad can produce read data for multiple subrequests in parallel, but a narrow response interface often carries only one logical tag group at a time. If the merge logic forwards all valid bank replies in one shot without first selecting a single tag and holding the request until that tag's banks are drained, the design can mix data from different requests into one response transaction.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A queued shared-memory read produces same-cycle bank replies belonging to more than one logical response tag.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Merge all valid bank replies into one response batch and allow the request queue to advance before all banks for the selected tag have been returned.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop tag-homogeneity filter and early-pop guard
portability_notes: This applies to banked SRAM or scratchpad designs with per-bank responses and a narrower core response bus.
The critical property is that only one logical tag group should be emitted per response transaction.
If your DUT uses thread masks or lane IDs instead of tags, map the same rule onto that grouping field.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that merges per-bank read data onto the shared response bus.
Remove the check that restricts forwarded bank replies to a single selected tag or request group.
Make the request queue pop when any read response can advance, instead of waiting until the full selected group is drained.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Shared-memory bank response batching and creq_pop control
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds bank_rsp_sel state, selects one response tag at a time, forwards only matching banks, and delays creq_pop until the final batch for that tag fires.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_shared_mem, the new bank_rsp_sel/crsq_in_fire_last logic and the CORE_TAG_ID_BITS equality check are the functional fix points.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Concurrent bank reads with different tags can be merged into one core response, causing wrong data-to-tag association, dropped lanes, or misrouted read results.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, every valid bank reply directly contributed to core_rsp_valids_in/core_rsp_data_in and the queue popped as soon as the skid buffer was ready.
After the fix, tag selection and last-batch tracking explicitly serialize heterogeneous-tag replies.
The commit message explicitly identifies a multi-tag shared-memory bug.
notes: A minimal reinjection is to remove the tag-match predicate while keeping the rest of the plumbing intact.
A second reinjection option is to restore the earlier read-request pop rule so the queue advances before the full response group is emitted.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 shared-memory 读响应组装逻辑，使不同 tag 的 bank 返回数据按批次分别返回，而不是混合到同一次响应中。
why_it_counts: 补丁完全位于 shared-memory RTL 中。
它修改了读响应的实时选择、分批以及队列出队时机。
如果没有该修复，不同 tag 请求的数据会被混在同一个响应总线上。
evidence: 提交新增 bank_rsp_sel 状态，用来跟踪当前 tag 已经发送了哪些 bank 响应。
core_rsp_tag_in 会先被选出，然后只转发 CORE_TAG_ID_BITS 与其匹配的 bank。
creq_pop 现在等待 crsq_in_fire_last，而不是在响应 skid buffer 一 ready 就弹出读请求。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: banked shared-memory 或 scratchpad 可能会并行产生多个子请求的读数据，但更窄的响应接口通常一次只能承载一个逻辑 tag 组。如果合并逻辑在没有先选定单一 tag、也没有等该 tag 的所有 bank 都返回完之前，就把所有有效 bank 响应一起转发，那么不同请求的数据就会被错误地拼进同一个响应事务里。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多 bank 读响应的 tag 分批逻辑
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个排队的 shared-memory 读请求在同一周期产生了属于多个逻辑响应 tag 的 bank 返回。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把所有有效 bank 返回都合并进同一批响应，并允许请求队列在选定 tag 尚未全部返回前就提前前进。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除 tag 同质性过滤并恢复过早 pop
portability_notes: 适用于具有 per-bank 响应且核心响应总线更窄的 banked SRAM 或 scratchpad 设计。
关键约束是：一次响应事务只能输出一个逻辑 tag 组。
如果 DUT 用 thread mask 或 lane ID 而不是 tag，也应把同样规则映射到对应分组字段上。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把各个 bank 的读数据合并到共享响应总线的逻辑。
删除只允许单一选定 tag 通过的检查条件。
把请求队列的出队条件改成“任意读响应可前进即可”，而不是等完整的选定组全部发完。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Shared-memory bank 响应分批与 creq_pop 控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增 bank_rsp_sel 状态，一次只选择一个响应 tag，只转发匹配 bank，并把 creq_pop 推迟到该 tag 的最后一批响应发出时。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_shared_mem 中，新增的 bank_rsp_sel/crsq_in_fire_last 逻辑以及 CORE_TAG_ID_BITS 相等判断，就是功能性修复锚点。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 并发 bank 读且 tag 不同时，核心侧可能收到被错误合并的响应，表现为数据和 tag 对不上、lane 丢失或读结果被错路由。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，每个有效 bank 回复都会直接参与 core_rsp_valids_in/core_rsp_data_in，且队列在 skid buffer ready 时就弹出。
修复后，tag 选择和 last-batch 跟踪显式串行化了不同 tag 的回复。
提交标题明确指出这是 multi-tag shared-memory bug。
notes: 最小化回注方式是删除 tag 匹配谓词，同时保留其他连线不变。
另一种回注方式是恢复旧的读请求 pop 规则，让队列在完整响应组输出前就前进。
